window.title: Phase Setup
lang.label: Setup language
welcome.fresh.title:
Play with friends
over the internet.
welcome.fresh.sub: Phase connects Minecraft Java Edition as if you were all on the same local network.
welcome.update.title:
Update Phase
to version {version}.
welcome.update.sub: Version {current} is installed now. Your profiles, friends and settings stay in place.
welcome.updateUnknown.sub: Your profiles, friends and settings stay in place.
welcome.reinstall.title:
Phase {version}
is already installed.
welcome.reinstall.sub: You can put the program files back in place. Your profiles, friends and settings won't change.
welcome.downgrade.title:
Go back to
Phase {version}?
welcome.downgrade.sub: A newer version, {current}, is installed now. Your profiles, friends and settings stay in place.
card.folderLocked: Updates stay in the same folder
card.autostartOn: Phase will wait in the tray
dir.noWrite: You don't have permission to write to this folder.
dir.replace: Phase.exe in this folder will be replaced.
path.notAbsolute: Enter a full path, such as D:\Games\Phase.
path.driveRoot: Phase can't be installed in the root of a drive.
path.badName: This path contains characters or names Windows doesn't allow.
path.notAFolder: There is a file at this path.
path.systemFolder: This is a system folder. Choose another one.
path.insideData: This folder is inside Phase's data. Choose another one.
done.install.title:
Phase is installed.
Time to play.
done.install.sub: You'll find it in the Start menu. You can remove it from Windows Settings.
done.update.title:
Phase is updated
to version {version}.
done.update.sub: Your profiles, friends and settings are in place.
running.title:
Phase is
open right now.
running.sub: It needs to close before setup can continue. If a room is open, Phase will ask you first.
running.closing: Waiting for Phase to close. If it asked about your room, answer in its window.
running.unsupported: This version of Phase can't close on request. Right-click the Phase icon near the clock, choose Quit, then come back here.
running.still: Phase is still open. Quit it from the icon near the clock, or answer the question in its window.
failed.title:
Setup couldn't
finish.
failed.rolledBack: All changes were undone. Your previous version and data are in place.
cancelled.title:
Setup was
cancelled.
cancelled.sub: Nothing changed. Everything is as it was before you started.
uninstall.title:
Remove Phase
from this PC?
uninstall.sub: The program, its shortcuts and its Windows entries will be removed. Profiles and settings stay unless you choose otherwise.
uninstall.dataOff: Profiles, device keys and friends are kept
uninstall.dataWarning: Device keys and your list of allowed friends will be lost for good. Friends will have to allow you again.
uninstalled.title:
Phase is removed.
See you around.
uninstalled.kept: Profiles and settings are still in {path}. If you come back, everything will be there.
uninstalled.removed: The program and its profile data were removed.
uninstalled.partial: The program was removed, but some data couldn't be deleted. You can delete it by hand: {path}.
error.installedElsewhere: Phase is already installed in {path}. Update it there or uninstall it first.
error.phaseRunning: Phase is running. Close it and try again.
error.noWriteAccess: No permission to write to {path}. Choose another folder.
error.notEnoughDisk: {need} MB is needed and {free} MB is free. Free up some space or choose another drive.
error.diskFull: The disk ran out of space while writing. Free up some space and try again.
error.corruptPayload: Download setup again from phase.yeskendir.com. This file was changed or didn't download completely.
error.fileLocked: Another program is using {path}. Close it and try again.
error.notInstalled: Phase wasn't found in this folder.
native.title: Phase Setup
native.webviewAsk:
The setup window needs Microsoft Edge WebView2, which isn't on this PC.

Download it from Microsoft and install it?
native.webviewDeclined: The setup window can't open without WebView2. You can run setup again later.
native.webviewFailed:
WebView2 couldn't be installed: {detail}

Check your internet connection and run setup again.
